description: Linear Merge Expander: adds another eight CV inputs and another CV output to a Linear Merge, and goes immediately to the right of it or of another of these expanders

params.text: Cycles how this expander's CV output is refreshed: S&H samples it as the parent's output gate goes high and holds it, T&H follows the chosen CV while that gate stays high
Cycles which high channel sets this CV output: First and Last by position from the top, Min and Max by voltage, Avg their mean, Sum their total, and Prev the channel the selector to the left chose

inputs.text: One of the eight CV inputs, taken when the gate on the parent Linear Merge at the same height is high and the selection button picks that channel

outputs.text: Carries the CV of the channel the selection button picks, refreshed as the mode button says

notes: the gates are on the parent Linear Merge; this module has none of its own, and its output stays at 0V until a Linear Merge is found to its left
a lamp at the top left glows yellow while a parent Linear Merge has been found, across any expanders in between
